headline: Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority: Vessels will face restrictions on future passage, including fines, detention, or confiscation

evidence.dominant_driver: Incremental tightening of Hormuz passage risk within an already heavily priced geopolitical/oil shock.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: High oil and inflation keep tightening expectations elevated.

absorption.reason: Oil and equity risk-off moves were already substantial before detection; this headline adds enforcement detail rather than opening a new conflict.

evidence.decision_notes: Residual-move forecast from detection time; headline is a continuation of the Hormuz cluster, not an independent fresh war shock.

immediate.rationale: Risk-off/oil shock confirmed but partly priced.

next_session.rationale: Further direction depends on actual enforcement and oil follow-through.

15m.rationale: Incremental shipping restriction headline can extend current risk-off move.

4h.rationale: Move is already extended and other drivers are mixed.

next_session.rationale: Needs evidence of actual detentions/disruption to sustain a new leg lower.

predictions.mechanism: Hormuz enforcement risk -> oil/inflation risk -> tighter financial conditions and lower equities.
predictions.invalidation: Shipping remains normal, no enforcement occurs, and crude/VIX reverse.
predictions.counter_case: Because the story is incremental and equities are already weak, absence of enforcement could trigger a relief rebound.

immediate.rationale: Risk-off plus high yields hit duration-sensitive tech.

next_session.rationale: AI selloff already contributes heavily; geopolitical residual may fade.

15m.rationale: Confirmed risk-off tape can extend briefly.

1h.rationale: High yields and oil reinforce tech downside.

4h.rationale: Headline is partly priced and tech has separate AI-driven weakness.

next_session.rationale: Needs new physical disruption for continued geopolitical downside.

predictions.mechanism: Oil/inflation and near-5% long yields raise discount-rate pressure on growth equities.
predictions.invalidation: Oil/yields reverse and tech selling stabilizes.
predictions.counter_case: A relief bounce is plausible if no actual ship detention follows and AI-related selling exhausts.

immediate.rationale: Europe remains exposed to imported-energy inflation.

next_session.rationale: Already high Bund yields/oil may have absorbed much of the shock.

15m.rationale: Fresh enforcement wording can pressure European risk assets.

1h.rationale: Energy and rate backdrop confirms downside.

4h.rationale: Incremental nature and existing selloff reduce residual edge.

predictions.mechanism: Higher oil import costs and inflation risk tighten European financial conditions.
predictions.invalidation: Brent reverses and shipping restrictions remain rhetorical.
predictions.counter_case: European indices can rebound if the authority's warning is not enforced and oil retraces.

next_session.rationale: Partly priced geopolitical premium limits residual certainty.

15m.rationale: Incremental Hormuz restriction supports near-term risk-off.

1h.rationale: Oil and yields confirm inflationary pressure.

4h.rationale: Existing positioning and extension raise reversal risk.

next_session.rationale: Actual enforcement is needed for persistent downside.

predictions.mechanism: Shipping risk raises energy costs and weighs on euro-area equities.
predictions.invalidation: No enforcement plus falling crude and yields.
predictions.counter_case: A relief rally can emerge if the new restriction language proves administrative rather than disruptive.

immediate.rationale: Geopolitical bid conflicts with strong dollar/high yields and an existing gold selloff.

next_session.rationale: No clear cross-asset confirmation for a safe-haven upside call.

15m.rationale: Headline can spark two-way safe-haven/rates reaction.

1h.rationale: Dollar/yields remain a strong bearish offset.

4h.rationale: Need either oil escalation or yield reversal for directional edge.

next_session.rationale: Conflicting geopolitical and rates forces remain unresolved.

predictions.mechanism: Hormuz risk supports haven demand, while DXY and high yields suppress non-yielding gold.
predictions.invalidation: Clear break in cross-asset balance: either yields/DXY fall sharply or geopolitical risk fades.
predictions.counter_case: Gold can continue lower despite escalation if Fed tightening expectations and the dollar remain dominant.
